name: a portable flamethrower: tanks on the back, a gun with a rear grip and its fuel valve trigger, a front grip with the igniter (M2)

manuals.title: a public-domain manual of the M2-2 portable flamethrower (a US Army field or technical manual of the 1940s or 1950s)
manuals.covers: the grips, igniting, firing bursts, the fuel valve

valve.what: the fuel valve lever under the rear grip, squeezed

igniter.what: the igniter trigger at the front grip

sources: the tanks are refilled, not reloaded in the field: no reload clip; the game's fuel comes from its own rules

beats.why: the valve squeezed: fuel flows through the flame
